verdict: CONFIRMED — the production database (neondb @ ep-ancient-cake-a52e4kfd) was dropped/recreated server-side overnight Oct 22->23. The entire syllabai of-record schema (71 tables) and all persisted content are GONE from the server. What exists there now: an 18 MB database holding a non-SyllabAI template schema (Assignment/AssignmentClass/AssignmentTask/AssignmentTaskState/Class/Enrollment/Resource/User) + neon_auth schema (Managed Better Auth enabled). Operator has confirmed the template app is theirs ('supposed to be addition to syllabai'). Data recovery: no Neon-server copy is reachable from here; the reliable path is deterministic re-derivation from git (see recovery_order).
method: fetch-first repo read + read-only SQL probes via pooler (postgres-js, scripts held outside repo, credentials env-only, never written to disk) + Vercel API read-only env/deploy reads. No Neon project touched, no schema changes, no writes of any kind.
